history.summary: A freehold 527sqft 1BR in D12 (Balestier/Boon Keng fringe) at $898k — but the eye-catching 11.8% appreciation rests on only 5 transactions and is statistically meaningless, while the location is poor for the format (1.4km / 17min to the nearest MRT). Boutique freehold shoebox with no transit and unverifiable upside.
history.rating_rationale: The 11.8% CAGR is a 5-transaction artifact — ignore it. On fundamentals: freehold and low quantum are the pluses, but a 1BR shoebox 1.4km from any MRT is a weak rental/resale proposition (small-unit tenants prize MRT proximity above all), and the development is a thin-data boutique. At-or-below the $1877 median PSF doesn't rescue a poorly-located shoebox. Freehold keeps it off Avoid; everything else caps it at Neutral.
red_flags: 11.8% appreciation from only 5 transactions — meaningless, do not rely on it
1.4km (17min) from nearest MRT — poor transit for a shoebox that needs it most
Boutique development, thin liquidity — hard investor exit
catalysts: Freehold tenure at a low $898k quantum
Balestier/Novena fringe — proximity to medical hub (Novena) for tenant demand
